definitions.explanation: Making something lighter, less severe, or less burdensome. Used for taxes, workloads, pain, and other burdens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽減|けいげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{軽減|けいげん}⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The reduced tax rate is applied to food products.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽減|けいげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine has the effect of alleviating pain.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in business, government, and medical contexts. The {軽減|けいげん}⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧ (reduced tax rate) became a major topic in Japan when the consumption tax was raised to 10% in 2019, with certain items like food kept at 8%.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧{軽減|けいげん} (burden reduction)
- {軽減|けいげん}⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧ (reduced tax rate)
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軽減|けいげん} (pain alleviation)
- {軽減|けいげん}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧ (relief measures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧: reduction — focuses on cutting back amounts or costs
- ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧: easing, relaxation — used for regulations, tensions, or symptoms
